LanguageData.USAC_FactionDesc: A vast corporation born out of this world's enlightenment. After the colonial fleet departed, it used its hold on information and technology to monopolize the local energy industry, then expanded across the rim on the back of its cultural dominance.
LanguageData.USAC_CorpseBag_EjectDesc: Eject the body from this bag.
LanguageData.USAC_CorpseBag_CurrencyDesc: The total market value of your body bags. USAC traders accept body bags as currency.
LanguageData.USAC_HostilityResetDesc: USAC has called off its hostility. They are neutral toward you once again.
LanguageData.USAC_MiningRigExtracting: The USAC mining rig is preparing to evacuate.
LanguageData.USAC_MiningRaidFailed: The USAC mining raid failed. No usable deep resources were found.
LanguageData.USAC_DeactivateMechDesc: Put this mech into hibernation. It can still be moved, and reactivated later.
LanguageData.USAC_Bond_Desc: A registered certificate of value, printed on high-strength fiber paper and issued by USAC corporate dealers to those who trade with their ground forces. Special inks give it an intricate anti-counterfeiting pattern, alongside the registered holder's details.\n\nOnce goods are bought and equipment sold, whatever residual value remains can be converted into these certificates, locking in fixed purchasing power for the next deal. Since each bond is registered, nobody but its holder can spend it - which makes this very durable piece of paper all but worthless to anyone else on the rim.
LanguageData.USAC_Currency_Desc: The total value you can spend with USAC merchants, counting both body bags and credit bonds. USAC traders accept nothing else as payment. Bonds are spent first; body bags are only used once the bonds run out, starting with the least valuable bag.
LanguageData.USAC_Currency_UntilNextBag: Spendable before the next bag is used: {0}
LanguageData.MessageTargetMustBeMechanoid: The target must be a mechanoid.
LanguageData.MessageTargetMustBePlayerMech: The target must be one of your own mechanoids.
LanguageData.USAC_MessageMechRepaired: All damage to {0} has been repaired.
LanguageData.TraderArrivalNoFaction: They belong to no known faction.
LanguageData.USAC_LetterTextCoverup: {0} covered for your operation. Several outposts were attacked and destroyed by {1}, and nothing ever pointed back to you. The elimination was a complete success.
LanguageData.USAC_FourPersonStart_GameStartDialog:
The emergency siren cuts through the roar of reentry. USAC has already written this loss off as acceptable risk.
You are four survivors, each from a different contract chain: inherited debt, automation layoffs, penal security work, and frontier hazard labor. Supplies are short, support is gone, and every promise ever made to you now depends on what you can build and defend on this rimworld.
LanguageData.USAC_DebtSite_CommercialRaid_Desc: Intelligence gathered at a USAC commercial site shows that it sold details of the weak points in your defenses, baiting a pirate assault on your colony.
LanguageData.USAC_DebtSite_ArtilleryStrike: Artillery spotters detected at a USAC site...
LanguageData.USAC_DebtSite_AirStrike: Aerial spotters detected at a USAC airfield...
LanguageData.USAC_ArtillerySupport_LetterText: A USAC artillery position nearby has answered the assault on your colony. Its spotters have marked your settlement, and bombardment is on its way. Take cover!
LanguageData.USAC_AirbaseSupport_LetterText: A temporary USAC airfield nearby has sent a tactical bomber wing to your coordinates in support of the ground offensive. The strike is seconds from the target area!
LanguageData.USAC_MechOrder_Register: Pay USAC registration fee for {0} ({1} bonds)
LanguageData.USAC_MechOrder_Registered: {0} registered with USAC. Drop pod inbound ({1} bonds spent).
